14c_1_band_structure.png: The free Kohn-Sham levels against the 3-momentum $k$ (units of $H$) at the slice $a_{4,0} = 0$ for $m = 1$, $L = 3$; vertical axis the level in units of $m$. The fold band (thick) starts at the zero mode and is exactly the straight line $\varepsilon = \kappa k$ ($\kappa = 1$ at this slice), with the orbital $(e^{fMy}, 0)$ for every $k$; the other levels start at or above the bulk edge $1.2923\,m$ (dash-dotted) and bend upward along the hyperbolas $\varepsilon^2 = \varepsilon(0)^2 + \kappa^2k^2$ (the even levels of label 1 of the two block types are equal, so the purple curve hides the orange one); the dashed line is the band of the blocks $j = -1$, the mirror image $-\kappa k$, which belongs to the sea.
14c_2_band_slope.png: The slope $c = d\varepsilon/dk$ of the fold band at $k = 0$. Left: against the slice $a_{4,0}$ from 0 to 2, logarithmic vertical axis; the numerical Richardson values (dots) lie on the exact line $c = \kappa = e^{-a_{4,0}}$: the band is redshifted along the history. Right: the numerical slope for six pairs of mass $M$ and cutoff $L$ (units of $m$ and $1/H$) at the slices 0 (left bars) and 1 (right bars): every value is $1$ or $e^{-1}$ (dotted lines), whatever $M$ and $L$, because the band orbital $(e^{fMy}, 0)$ has $\chi^\dagger\sigma_3\chi = \chi^\dagger\chi$ and $\kappa$ is the same at every $y$.
14c_3_band_redshift.png: The fold band along the prescribed deflating history. Left: the band $\varepsilon = \kappa k$ (units of $m$) against the 3-momentum $k$ (units of $H$) at the five slices $a_{4,0} = 0$ to $2$: straight lines with the slopes $e^{-a_{4,0}}$, later slices lower. Right, against the slice on a logarithmic vertical axis: the gap of the eight zero modes, the band level at the first lattice shell $\kappa\Delta k = 0.25e^{-a_{4,0}}$ (line; dots at the five slices of the record), and the two lowest levels away from the band at $k = 0$ (odd label 0, even label 1), which rise along the history because the proper length $fL = 3e^{-a_{4,0}/3}$ of the cut-off half shrinks.
14c_4_block_type_mirror.png: The levels of the even fold condition with labels $-2$ to $2$ against the 3-momentum $k$ (units of $H$), slice 0, $m = 1$, $L = 3$; vertical axis the level in units of $m$. Left the blocks $j = +1$, right the blocks $j = -1$: each picture is the other one reflected in the line $\varepsilon = 0$ (label $l$ goes to $-l$), the exact relation $h_{-1} = -h_{+1}$; the rising straight line of the label 0 on the left is the fold band $\varepsilon = \kappa k$, the falling one on the right its sea partner.
14c_5_tip_angle.png: The change of two levels at the 3-momentum $k = 0.25$ when the tip condition $(1 - Q(\theta))\chi(-L) = 0$ is changed from $\theta = 0$ to $\theta$ (horizontal axis, radians), for $m = 1$, $L = 3$, at the slices $a_{4,0} = 0$ (blue) and $1.5$ (red), logarithmic vertical axis in units of $m$. Circles: the fold band (label 0), whose orbital has only the small tail $a_0(-L)^2 = 2fMe^{-2fML}/(1 - e^{-2fML})$ at the tip; dotted: the first-order estimate $\tan(\theta/2)a_0(-L)^2/f$ of its shift. Squares: the extended level of label 1, which nothing suppresses toward the tip: it moves by about $0.01$ to $0.33\,m$ at the slice 0 and $0.02$ to $0.50\,m$ at the slice 1.5, the band by about $0.0003$ to $0.006\,m$ and $0.003$ to $0.05\,m$. At the later slice the hidden direction is shorter ($f = e^{-1/2}$), the tail is larger and the band shifts more.
14c_6_closed_shells.png: The closed shells of the free aufbau: the particle number $N$ (logarithmic axis) against the energy of the last filled level (units of $m$), at the slices $a_{4,0} = 0$ (solid) and $0.5$ (dashed), for $m = 1$, $L = 3$, $\Delta k = 0.25$. Each step is one group of degenerate levels; the red dots mark the particle numbers $N = 8$ (the zero modes), $592$ and $2352$ of the Revision runs; $2352$ is the last closed shell below the bulk edge $1.2923\,m$ (dash-dotted line); at the later slice the redshifted fold band holds many more particles below the same energy.
